new_dtos: ObserveVerb { Create, List, Delete, Query, Update } (tagged enum, JSON verb discriminator; Update rejected with Unsupported per m7-02 scoping)
ObserveCondition { Tripwire { condition, label }, Uprobe { binary_path, symbol_name, pid, label } }
ObserveAction { Record, Notify, InjectUprobe } (InjectUprobe parsed-but-no-op per m7-02 scoping)
ObserveRetention { Drained (default), RetainedUntilSessionEnd, Permanent } (Permanent rejected with Unsupported)
ObserveRequestedEvidence { Snapshot, Replay, Properties } (Properties rejected with Unsupported)
ObserveInput { verb, subscription_id, condition, action, retention, requested_evidence, scope, cursor, label }
ObserveOutput { Create(ObserveCreateResult), List(ObserveListResult), Delete(ObserveDeleteResult), Query(ObserveQueryResult), Update(NoopUpdateResult) }
ObserveCreateResult { subscription_id, kind, status, active_count, label, attached_pid }
FiredEventDto { tripwire_id, condition_description, event_id, timestamp_ns, thread_id }

retentions_implemented: RetainedUntilSessionEnd (approximated by returning [] for fired_events in query path)

known_limitations.reason: Per m7-02 scoping (docs/milestones/m7-02-observability-scoping.md §Decision 1): requires domain-layer mutation API not yet present
known_limitations.future: m7+ when tripwire subscription mutations are supported at the domain layer

known_limitations.reason: Per m7-02 scoping (§Decision 5): TripwireManager does not distinguish permanent retention today
known_limitations.future: m7+ if permanent-retention storage is added to TripwireManager

known_limitations.reason: Per m7-02 scoping (§Decision 2): Properties field exists in the v1 schema but the tripwire event payload does not carry it
known_limitations.future: m7+ when TripwireEvent gains a Properties field

known_limitations.reason: Per m7-02 scoping (§Decision 3): True fire-on-condition uprobe injection requires domain-layer change deferred to m7+. Today the uprobe is attached once at subscription creation when ObserveCondition::Uprobe is used (mirrors v1 probe_inject semantics).

known_limitations.always: approximated by returning fired_events=[] in observe verb=query path
known_limitations.reason: Today the tripwire manager drains fired events on read. The query path returns [] rather than a snapshot. Callers needing true non-destructive retention must use Drained (default) and rely on verb=list semantics.
known_limitations.future: m7+ when TripwireManager exposes retention-aware read

known_limitations.reason: CursorDto fields (total_pushed, snapshot_len) are encoded but cannot be cross-checked against TripwireManager state — CursorStale/InvalidCursorPayload errors are defined but not raised on the observe path
known_limitations.future: m7+ when TripwireManager exposes cursor validation

known_limitations.always: rewritten from "uprobe attached to '<symbol>' in '<binary>' (pid <pid>);" to "uprobe attached (subscription <id>);"
known_limitations.reason: The structured fields (binary_path, symbol_name, pid) are preserved as top-level keys so callers that parse them keep working; only the human-readable summary changes shape
known_limitations.future: v1 sunset 2027-09-11 — once probe_inject is removed, callers migrate to observe

known_limitations.reason: Preserves v1 contract: an ID like 'uprobe-foo' that does not start with 'tripwire-' is rejected at the MCP boundary even though ObserveDelete is verb-routed

notes: Decisions locked in m7-02 scoping (5525180) carried over to execute cycle verbatim: verb=update rejected, properties evidence rejected, action=inject_uprobe parsed-but-no-op, cursor optional on verb=list, retention default Drained, cursor validation best-effort.

ObserveCondition::Tripwire carries parsed chronos_domain::tripwire::TripwireCondition (not raw JSON) to avoid a circular dependency between chronos-services and chronos-domain. The MCP layer does the TripwireConditionType → TripwireCondition parsing before constructing the v2 typed input.

Uprobe subscriptions register a sentinel TripwireCondition::FunctionName { pattern = symbol_name } so they appear in tripwire list/query/delete under the same lifecycle. This keeps the v1 tripwire_id-based contract intact for uprobe subscriptions too.
Test rig uses TestRig::with_ctx(|ctx| { ... }) closure pattern (no unsafe) to manage ProbeContext lifetime. Solved E0515/E0505 borrow errors during iteration.
Used #[derive(Default)] with #[default] on Drained variant for ObserveRetention per clippy::derivable_impls lint.
No clippy drift introduced; no module-level #[allow] needed beyond the pre-existing chronos_store::SessionMetadata line.
